remarks: Soak in that 'By the Water' feeling all year long and experience sophisticated waterfront living in this beautifully renovated 1-bedroom corner unit at The Village at Stamford Landing, where every detail has been designed for comfort and style. The expanded, fully renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a large pantry-perfect for year round entertaining. The sunlit open living/dining area offers a gas fireplace with a sleek tiled mantle and sliders to your private patio, ideal for morning coffee or evening sunsets overlooking the marina. The spa-inspired bath includes a Kohler heated jacuzzi tub, custom tilework, and a Woodbridge bidet toilet for a touch of luxury. Additional highlights include a new water heater (2022), new living room heating/cooling unit (2022), and 2 garage parking spaces. Enjoy resort-style amenities including a pool, hot tub, beautifully landscaped grounds, a community dog run and waterfront boardwalk connecting you to Harbor Point's vibrant restaurants, parks, bars, and shops. Minutes to Metro-North, Downtown Stamford, Old Greenwich, and I-95, this is effortless coastal living at its best-stylish, convenient, and move-in ready.
